metricDefinitions.Recall@K: For the 10 cases with non-empty reviewed relevantPaperIds, intersection(relevantPaperIds, rankedPaperIds[1..K]) divided by relevantPaperIds count; empty-set cases excluded from recall denominator.
metricDefinitions.Hit@5: For the 10 cases with non-empty reviewed relevantPaperIds, whether at least one relevant paper appears in rankedPaperIds[1..5].
metricDefinitions.MRR: For the 10 cases with non-empty reviewed relevantPaperIds, reciprocal rank of the first relevant paper; zero if none appears in the observed top-5.
metricDefinitions.emptySetCases: Reported separately and not scored as recall zero.

emptySetCaseResults.reviewNote: The service returns nearest candidates; the reviewed relevance set is empty, so answer-layer policy must not treat retrieval presence as relevance.
The 2099-2100 window has no trusted result and correctly fails closed.

limitations: Metrics are based on one captured retrieval observation per case.
The 0007 empty-set case demonstrates that nearest-neighbor retrieval can return candidates for an irrelevant query; it is not a false pass.
This review is authorized Codex review, not independent human inter-rater review.
